## Required

Nine fields: four IDs; sampling period and method; first length's type, value and tool.

## Available

The 17 observer trips contain 4,023 lengths for 4,013 individuals. Ten turtles have two different length measures.

Recorded tools include 1,140 Unknown values. No individual weights or maturity values occur in this selection.

## To decide

Keep one specimen per actual animal, with its measurements together; do not create a fish per measurement.

Establish sampling period/method, measurement correspondences and stable specimen IDs.

Ask Emmanuel how to report unmeasured animals with SSI or tag information.

An empty sheet is structurally possible only without SSI or tag rows; the reporting rule remains open.
